source_caption:
📺 The Ms. Pat Show (2021–Present)

The Ms. Pat Show follows Patricia “Ms. Pat” Carson, a fearless and outspoken mother who moves her family from Atlanta to suburban Indiana in search of a better life. Adjusting to a new environment isn’t easy, especially with her brutally honest personality, unpredictable family situations, and hilarious parenting style. Alongside her husband and children, Ms. Pat tackles everyday challenges involving marriage, raising teenagers, friendships, and family disagreements. Inspired by comedian Ms. Pat’s real-life experiences, the series combines outrageous humor with heartfelt moments, showing how love, resilience, and laughter can help a family overcome life’s toughest situations.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creators: Patricia Williams & Jordan E. Cooper

📺 Where to Watch: Paramount+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Ms. Pat Show is an American television sitcom created by Jordan E. Cooper and Patricia "Ms. Pat" Williams that premiered on the streaming service BET+ on August 12, 2021. The show is based on the comedy and life story of comedian Ms. Pat as a convicted felon from the streets of Atlanta turned reluctant suburban mother. The series has received nominations for 4 Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Directing for a Comedy Series.
